assessments.reasoning: Mozilla's own MPL 2.0 plaintext supplies the operative designation. The reported range [14746,15009) and its digest match the frozen locator for section 10.1. Its exception qualifies authority over versions while preserving the named role.

challenge.method: Followed section 10.1's express exception to section 10.3 and checked the object of the reproduction grant in section 2.1(a).
challenge.results: Section 10.3 allows a renamed, modified license for other software under specified conditions, without appointing another steward. Section 2.1(a) grants rights in a contributor's Contributions. Neither provision displaces the designation or establishes a standalone publisher-document reuse grant.

limitations: This finding identifies the steward under MPL 2.0. Permission to redistribute the complete license document as a standalone dataset item is a separate proposition.
reasoning: Section 10.1, “New Versions”, expressly assigns the license steward role to Mozilla Foundation.
